limitations.note: Renaming the existing slave_mod ports from a and b to data_a and data_b broke compatibility with callers using the original named ports, which the TopModule-only simulation did not check.
Replacing the comparator's if/else with a ternary changed four-state simulation behavior: when the comparison is unknown, the ternary can propagate X bits where the original selected a.
The test launcher had to be submitted three times: the first attempt used a disallowed cleanup command, and the second invoked an unavailable Python executable.
